To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the individual motivations of knowledge contributors in the PSVCs are influenced by the characteristics of the PSVCs, which in turn influence knowledge contribution intention.

the characteristics of PSVC, such as codification, virtual community norms, communication methods, identity management and virtual community motive, are positively related to knowledge contribution intention, and this effect is mediated by members' individual motivation to contribute knowledge.
individual motivations mediate the relationships between characteristics in PSVCs and intention of knowledge contribution.
In summary, our research is concerned with
understanding the motivational mechanisms in the context of knowledge contribution in PSVCs, and provides insights for both researchers and managers.
the motivational mechanism in PSVCs.
how to motivate members to contribute more knowledge in the problem solving context.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the more members perceive that PSVCs are able to provide active learning opportunities, enhance their self-worth, encourage them to reciprocate, provide them with reputation, help others enjoy, protect them, make them feel morally obligated, and promote the virtual community motive, the higher their knowledge contribution intention would be.

the more members are motivated by the four individual motivations (i.e., self-protection, active learning, reciprocity and enjoyment of helping others), the more likely they are to contribute to the PSVC.
the characteristics of PSVC, including the codification, identity, norms, and communication methods, influence knowledge contribution intention by affecting members' individual motivations.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

individual motivations play an important role in knowledge contribution intention in PSVCs and the relationships between the mechanisms of PSVCs (i.e., codification, identity, norms and communication) and knowledge contribution intention are mediated by individual motivations.

we have identified eight individual motivations that drive individuals to knowledge contribution in PSVCs, and we also identified four major mechanisms that are associated with these individual motivations.
individual motivations are a key mechanism in understanding members' knowledge contribution in PSVCs.
The main takeaway from our work is that
individual motivations are the key drivers that determine members' knowledge contribution intention in PSVCs.
the mechanisms in PSVC can influence members' knowledge contribution through the mediation of individual motivations.
the mechanisms in PSVC can be leveraged to influence members' motivation to contribute.
